filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Mon Nov 2 – Tue Nov 3 PT

market_briefing.lede: Salesforce is folding Cresta's voice agents into Service Cloud, while Clay published a head-to-head showing GTM agents win more on organized account data than on model size. Anthropic's new message threads cut first-token wait for long agent sessions without changing token bill.

bullets.text: Nov 2: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cresta, whose voice agents handle complex calls end to end and coach human reps in real time; terms are undisclosed in the newsroom post (The Information reports about $2.7B). Close is aimed for Salesforce's fiscal Q1 2028, subject to approvals. Cresta will keep supporting customers' existing contact-center and telephony stacks after close.

Nov 3: Clay's Linda Ye and Nisola Shobayo blog says Account Agents on Clay's Audiences data layer used 6.4× fewer input tokens and answered 2.6× faster than a general-purpose agent on the same Salesforce/Gong facts, and caught a planted duplicate-account threat in 30/30 runs vs 18/30.

Nov 3: Anthropic put Messages API message threads in public beta — send the full history once, then only new turns plus the prior response id. Median time-to-first-token for 500k–1M-token requests drops about 35%; most Claude Code users have it on by default. Token usage is unchanged; threads expire five minutes after the last request.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic amends S-1 with $17B Q3 revenue and $895.4B compute commitments
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 2: CNBC reports the amended Form S-1 shows ~$17B Q3 revenue (+47% QoQ), $33.24B for the nine months ended Sept. 30, a $23.29B Q3 net loss, and ~$895.4B in purchase commitments and leases substantially for compute and infrastructure.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic ships message threads beta for long-running agents
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 3: public beta on the Claude Platform (also AWS, Microsoft Foundry, Google Cloud Anthropic-managed). Median TTFT falls ~35% on 500k–1M-token requests; Claude still reads the full conversation each turn.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors for flexible campus power demand
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 2: future compute campuses are meant to cut electricity draw when grids are strained. Georgia Effingham County pilot includes up to 1,000 MW of demand response with Georgia Power; OpenAI says it will pay full project infrastructure and service costs.

what_changed.title: Salesforce to acquire Cresta for voice agents in Service Cloud
what_changed.body: NEW. Nov 2 newsroom: definitive agreement to buy Cresta, the "voice-first operating system for customer experience." Cresta's agents resolve complex calls, coach human reps, and analyze interactions; named customers include Marriott, Comcast and Alaska Airlines. Expected close fiscal Q1 2028, subject to regulatory approvals. Purchase price not in the Salesforce post; The Information reports about $2.7B.

what_changed.title: Clay: GTM agent ceiling is the data layer, not the model
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent / product proof). Nov 3 blog: five synthetic enterprise accounts, same Salesforce+Gong facts for a generic MCP agent vs Clay Account Agents. Clay: 39K vs 250K average input tokens, 23s vs 60s answers, duplicate-account threat caught 30/30 vs 18/30. Framed as Audiences (canonical account + all fields + pre-organized context) beating retrieval luck.

what_changed.title: Anthropic message threads cut agent TTFT on long sessions
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 3 public beta: thread create/continue on Messages API so clients send only new messages after the first turn. ~35% median TTFT drop at 500k–1M tokens; on by default for most Claude Code users; 5-minute idle expiry.

what_changed.title: Anthropic IPO amendment details Q3 run-rate and near-$900B compute book
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 2 amended S-1 (via CNBC/Axios): ~$17B Q3 revenue, $33.24B YTD revenue, $895.4B aggregate compute/infrastructure commitments (~$70B due within 12 months per Axios).

quiet_note: No new launches, pricing or M&A from Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, Monaco or Nooks in the Nov 2–3 window. Gong and Outreach newsrooms still top out in mid-October. Nooks' company LinkedIn (Nov 2) claimed ~400 new customers in Q3, 49% Sequencing growth QoQ and "big announcements this week," without naming the products. Salesloft summit and Agentforce Coworker demos are tomorrow (Nov 4).

competitive_moves.title: Salesforce → Cresta (definitive agreement)
competitive_moves.body: Nov 2: Salesforce to acquire Cresta to unite voice agents and conversation intelligence with Service Cloud / Agentforce. Terms undisclosed officially; The Information reports ~$2.7B. Expected close fiscal Q1 2028.

watch.title: Nov 4: Salesloft Behind Every Win summit and Agentforce Coworker demos; Nooks product teases
watch.body: Salesloft's virtual summit runs 11 AM–1 PM ET (8–10 AM PT) with Forrester's Anthony McPartlin and Pixar storyteller Matthew Luhn — watch for Agentic Playbook pricing/GA. Salesforce+ runs Agentforce Coworker live demos the same day; Agent Evals / API Evals remain due for November beta. Nooks LinkedIn (Nov 2) said "some big announcements this week" after claiming ~400 new Q3 customers.

interpretation.fact: Salesforce announced a definitive agreement to acquire Cresta on Nov 2 (price not in the newsroom; The Information reports ~$2.7B). Clay published a Nov 3 benchmark claiming Account Agents used 6.4× fewer tokens and answered 2.6× faster than a generic Salesforce/Gong agent on the same facts. Anthropic's amended S-1 (Nov 2) shows ~$17B Q3 revenue and $895.4B compute commitments; Anthropic launched message threads public beta (Nov 3). OpenAI launched Grid Protectors (Nov 2). No product launches from Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, Monaco or Nooks were found for Nov 2–3.
interpretation.note: Interpretation: Salesforce is buying conversation-native voice agents rather than only building them, which raises the bar for "AI CS" attach in CRM deals. Clay is arguing buyers should judge GTM agents by retrieval/data layer quality, not model brand — useful framing against MCP-to-CRM demos. Message threads make long coding/GTM agent sessions feel snappier without changing spend.

feed.summary: Clay says its Account Agents used 6.4× fewer tokens and answered 2.6× faster than a generic Salesforce/Gong agent on the same accounts, catching a planted duplicate-account threat in every run.
Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cresta, a voice-first customer-experience platform, to connect voice agents with Service Cloud.
Nooks said it signed about 400 new customers in Q3, grew Sequencing 49% over Q2, and teased product announcements later this week.
